name: Survive the Night
desc:
Welcome to Survive the Night! 

🏃 SURVIVAL MODE; run, hide, and do whatever you can to avoid dying!
🔨 Equip gears and perks to increase your odds against the slashers and killers!
🔦 Over 1000+ unique items to unlock and earn!
🔪 Take control of the slasher and hunt down the survivors!

🔫 HUNT MODE; work with your team to complete objectives and take down killers!
🔧 Use your weapons and tools to customize your operatives play style!
📌 Work with your team to complete various objectives and evac!

📕 STORY MODE; immerse yourself in the story of Survive the Night!
🔊 Voiced characters and mocapped cutscenes!
🧑‍🤝‍🧑 Play with up to 4 people, or go in solo!

This game is a remake of the 2016 classic hide & seek game "Before the Dawn"

scripts.features:
Script name: 'StarHack Hub,' also known as 'Deepstar Hub,' but the main name still being 'StarHack Hub.'
The script allows you to view the locations of all items (relics, blacklights...) and claim them instantly (without any cooldown), the script also allows you to teleport to the "Cases" (MurchCase, AILACase...) and claim them in less than a second, it also allows you to add speed and check for active items.
